modelError.auth_failed: the key is wrong or lacks access; check it under Models & fallback
modelError.missing_key: no key for this provider yet
modelError.model_not_found: the provider has no such model
modelError.model_id_missing: no model ID in the config
modelError.base_url_missing: no API address in the config
modelError.provider_error: the provider had an error; try again later
modelError.bad_request: the provider refused the request (bad parameters)
modelError.content_blocked: blocked by the provider's moderation; change the description
modelError.no_image: the model answered in text without a picture
modelError.video_too_short: the video came back shorter than asked
modelError.video_wrong_size: the video came back in the wrong aspect
modelError.insufficient_balance: the provider account is out of credit
modelError.quota_exceeded: the provider account is out of quota or hit a usage limit set in its console (billing not enabled, a trial limit); check the provider console
modelError.voice_not_found: the provider has no such voice
modelError.voice_id_missing: this voice has no provider voice ID; it can only be spoken locally
modelError.ref_unreadable: a reference picture could not be read
modelError.invalid_response: the provider's answer could not be read
modelError.adapter_unavailable: this model is not connected yet
modelError.comfy_not_running: Cannot reach ComfyUI; open it and try again
modelError.comfy_model_missing: ComfyUI lacks a model file this workflow needs; install it under Environment
modelError.comfy_node_missing: ComfyUI lacks a node this workflow needs; update ComfyUI under Environment
modelError.comfy_lost: The job left ComfyUI's queue (was the queue cleared?)
modelError.ref_missing: This workflow is missing an input (reference picture, first frame or audio)
modelError.not_installed: The local runtime is not installed yet; install it under Environment
modelError.worker_crashed: The local model process quit unexpectedly
